title: Everglades River of Grass Adventures

services.name: airboat ride
services.desc: When most travelers picture Miami in the summer, they imagine turquoise water, white sand, and vibrant nightlife. But just beyond the city’s skyline lies a completely different world-wild, untamed, ancient, and unforgettable. The Everglades, iconically known as the “River of Grass,” offers one of Florida’s most unique adventures, and there is no better way to explore it than by airboat. The Everglades is not a swamp or even your typically river- although, it is a river. It is a slow-moving sheet of water stretching across miles of sawgrass marsh. services.name: Fishing Tours
services.desc: Wet a line with the River of Grass and experience unforgettable Everglades fishing opportunities. Our Native guides know Florida’s waters and prime habitats for world-class angling like the back of their hands. From hooking Largemouth Bass on the River of Grass to targeting Snook in the Ten Thousand Islands backcountry, our trips are designed for anglers of all experience levels. Discover some of South Florida’s best Everglades bass fishing on a guided trip across the legendary River of Grass. Glide through freshwater marshes and pond apple trees in search of trophy largemouth bass scattered through the Spadderdock lilies. Bass action is seasonal and dependent upon water levels. 1-5 guests
